instrument_attributes.label: Expense Ratio (annual)
instrument_attributes.description: All-in annual fee charged on AUM. Stored as a percentage (e.g., 1.5 for 1.5% a.a.). Regional synonyms: management fee, taxa de administração, OCF (UCITS).

instrument_attributes.label: Performance Fee
instrument_attributes.description: Performance fee applied to returns above performance_benchmark/hurdle. Stored as a percentage (e.g., 20 for 20%). Zero or absent means no performance fee.

instrument_attributes.label: Performance Fee Benchmark
instrument_attributes.description: Benchmark used to compute the performance fee (e.g., CDI, IPCA+, IBOVESPA, S&P 500). May differ from the strategy benchmark.

instrument_attributes.label: Performance Fee Hurdle
instrument_attributes.description: Hurdle applied on top of performance_benchmark before the performance fee accrues (e.g., '100% of CDI', 'IPCA + 6%', 'high-water mark'). Free-form to capture regulamento/prospectus wording.
